messages:
eve-netops: Seeing an abrupt packet-loss spike on the eu-west2 -> eu-west2-az3 path, started ~10:48 UTC, loss ~6-12% on some flows :thinking_face:
alice-eng: Support thread: multiple customers reporting 502s and long tail latencies around same time. AcmeApp shows 15% failed requests since 10:50 UTC.
dana-support: I've got two escalations open (AcmeApp, NimbusAI). Both say 'requests hang then 502'. They included request IDs and curl repros.
ben-sre: Correlating now — p95 token latency jumped from 180ms to 1.2s, error rate (502/504) up x10 on hosted inference frontends in eu-west2.
monitor-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api-eu-west2: gateway_5xx_rate > threshold (last 5m)
alice-eng: Any sign of auth backend flapping? Customers mention intermittent auth errors too (401/429) in addition to 502s.
eve-netops: Auth backend looks healthy from app logs. I suspect provider-level packet loss causing retransmits and TCP timeouts between edge-pop and az3. BGP adjacencies show some micro-reorders.
ben-sre: Snapshot of frontend logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:51:12Z frontend-01 eu-west2 req_id=abcd123 status=502 backend_timeout=1200ms upstream_errors=conn_reset
2026-03-17T10:52:03Z frontend-02 eu-west2 req_id=efgh456 status=504 tcp_retrans=3
```
eve-netops: Provider (CarrierX) ticket opened — they acknowledge increased queueing on the regional transit. They suspect a misconfigured queue on one POP causing hairpin + bufferbloat.
dana-support: Customers keep asking for ETA, can we propose a mitigation? They've asked for dedicated capacity or region failover.
frank-ps: We can offer a temporary region-failover guide to affected customers, and whitelist for dedicated capacity if they want to move. But need platform-level mitigation first.
alice-eng: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) divert some traffic to eu-west1 region via smart routing policy 2) enable more aggressive connection timeouts and retry/backoff client hints 3) enable prefix/KV cache warm for heavy callers to reduce cross-AZ calls. Thoughts?
ben-sre: Start with rerouting non-SLA customers to eu-west1, keep tiered traffic in eu-west2 with stricter timeouts. I can push a routing rule for ~30% of traffic to eu-west1 for next 30m.
eve-netops: Also requesting provider to withdraw the bad route on the POP that is hairpinning. Waiting on CarrierX ops now.
infra-bot: deploy:route-rule push initiated by ben-sre — id=rr-20260317-01 — 30% -> eu-west1 (canary)
monitor-bot: [INFO] reroute policy applied, checking success metrics...
dana-support: Shared this with AcmeApp & NimbusAI, they want logs for their failing request IDs — attaching the IDs to the support tickets, will follow up if they can reproduce.
ben-sre: After reroute p95 dropped to ~300ms and 5xx rate reduced by 60% for canary traffic. But some residual errors remain for longer tail requests pinned to az3.
eve-netops: CarrierX confirms a queue config mismatch; they're rolling a fix on the POP. They estimate 30-45 minutes for full propagation.
alice-eng: Can we enable an automatic fallback where frontends try alternate upstreams on TCP retransmits >2? Might help during provider jitter. Not for this minute, but create an I/O to track.
frank-ps: I'll draft a customer-facing blurb: brief explanation + how to switch region for critical workloads + offer credits for affected windows.
dana-support: sending blurb now to legal & comms for signoff, then I'll post to customers.
ben-sre: Will keep the 30% reroute for 45m, then re-evaluate. Keeping detailed logs for postmortem.
eve-netops: CarrierX says fix rolling, will post update when propagation complete.
monitor-bot: [RESOLVE] gateway_5xx_rate returning to baseline for rerouted traffic; continue monitoring.
alice-eng: Postmortem TODOs: collect tcpdump from affected POPs, correlate BGP adj-change logs, quantify customer impact (requests/failed %), and add routing fallback for future hairpins.
dana-support: Closing customer tickets with interim mitigation steps; will update if they ask for more. :white_check_mark:
eve-netops: CarrierX propagated config at 11:25 UTC, packet loss on path dropped to <0.5%, metrics trending down.
ben-sre: Last check: p95 ~220ms, 5xx near baseline. Marking incident as mitigated; will move to postmortem in incidents channel.
infra-bot: incident: create postmortem template -> id=INC-20260317-euw2-hairpin
frank-ps: Thanks all — will follow up with customer communications and credits where appropriate.
monitor-bot: [NOTE] keep alert thresholds aggressive for next 6 hours for eu-west2 routing anomalies.
